name: Beauty By Bella Salon
address: Al Barsha First - Al Barsha - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Beauty by Bella Salon is a luxurious haven for beauty enthusiasts. Step into an elegant ambiance where expert stylists and beauticians offer a wide range of premium services, including hair styling, nail artistry, skincare, and more. Renowned for its exceptional attention to detail and personalized care, the salon uses top-quality products to ensure every client leaves feeling confident and radiant. Indulge in the ultimate pampering experience at Beauty by Bella.

reviews.author: Nariman Al Hindi
reviews.text: Love love love this saloon! I was exploring it for the first time and it sooo met my expectations! Its so clean and cozy with the pinky interiors. Very professional booking system. I was warmly welcomed by the lovely (RoseI went there for eyelashes extension, gelish pedicure and hard gel manicure and wow! Did my lashes with (Simran) and she made my lashes exactly how i wanted them. The hard gel manicure with (Annie) very beautiful shape and color. Finally the gelish pedicure with (Mary) super nice. All these ladies were efficient and charming. Am happy and satisfied, Will definitely come baaaack.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your review ,we are happy to see you satisfied and hope to see you again.

reviews.author: Afia Sheikh
reviews.text: I had a great experience getting my nails done! Kainat was gentle, detail-oriented, and really listened to what I wanted. My nails came out clean, even, and beautifully shaped. The salon was welcoming and the service was quick but never rushed. I’ll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Ruvini Bandara
reviews.text:
I messaged up my nails pretty bad - chipped it, and they were very sweet to accommodate my appointment for the same day. Nicely recovered - keeping the original shape with a cute nude shade of Gelish.
Kaynat (sorry if I misspelled it!) is super efficient and sweet❤️
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for taking your time to review us. We are glad you liked us. Hope to see you again ❤️

reviews.author: Tasheni Sasanka
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience today! Roma did a fantastic job with my keratin treatment—my hair feels silky and smooth. Annie was so gentle and precise with my gel nails, they look absolutely perfect! Also, the Rose , Cynthia and Simran havegave me at the end was such a sweet touch. The whole experience was relaxing and professional. Highly recommend!" 💖🫂

reviews.author: Sutasinee Kesungnoen
reviews.text: I’m absolutely in love with my nails! Thank you to Kainat for making me so happy — she is truly professional. I showed her a reference, and she recreated it exactly the way I wanted. All the staff were very kind and welcoming. I will definitely come back again for sure. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jennie Veronika
reviews.text: Today was the first time visiting this cute all pink saloon located in Al Barsha, I parked inside the building itself (on the back of the building). I got an appointment same day, and ended up doing both my nails (french extension) and pedicure with gel. I am super happy with the result and the lady’s name was Kaimat, she was fairly fast and very detailed oriented and asked me a couple of times if i wanted something to drink etc 💓🌸 Very sweet girl. The lady who did my pedicure was Mona, also very happy with my result. Very resonable priced.

reviews.author: Nikta Zamani
reviews.text: I went to the salon today for a manicure, pedicure, and gel refill. The atmosphere is super welcoming, and Cynthia and Mainardi were professional, skilled, and very gentle. I will definitely come back. I highly recommend it and can’t wait to return!
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Ms. Nikta,

Thank you for taking time to leave a review and for your feedback. it was a pleasure serving you and we look forward to serving you you again.

Thank you,
Beauty By Bella Team

reviews.author: Liss Gwinnett
reviews.text:
I have been going to the salon since May / June I think.
I genuinely love going here, I look forward to my pamper days. my nails by Kayanat are always immaculate and perfect, my gel pedicure is always amazing, my feet have never felt so smooth.

Beko does my lashes and I will only have her, she is perfect. Always listens to what I like/want and the results are PERFECT 🤍🤍
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Ms. Liss,

Thank you for taking time to write a review and for visiting our salon. It was a pleasure serving you. We appreciate your feedback as it helps us improve and motivates us and we will definitely look into the points mentioned. All our utensils are sterilized before use, we also use the manicure tray for easy access during service. Once again thank you, we hope to serve you again in the nearest future.

Warm Regards,
Beauty By Bella Team

Their attention to detail and professionalism really stood out.

reviews.author: Racheal Oyenuga
reviews.text:
What a transformation! My nails went from bare to breathtaking—thanks to Kainat’s magic touch. They look healthy, polished, and so well cared for. I couldn’t stop staring!

My hair? A dream. Cynthia and Hannah took down my braids and Hannah styled my natural hair quickly, yet so beautifully, shiny, clean, and full of life.

Rose at the reception was the cherry on top, so calm, welcoming, and thorough. She made the whole process seamless, from booking to final touches.

The best part? All three services were done in under 2 hours! Highly recommend Beauty by Bella. Splendid job, ladies!
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Ms. Racheal,

Thank you for taking time to give a detail review about your experience with us. The ladies are very glad to know that you are happy with their services and this motivates them to be at their best. We appreciate you and thank you for visiting. See you soon.

Warm Regards,
Beauty By Bella Team

reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this ladies’ salon! From the moment I stepped in, I felt welcomed and taken care of. The reception staff, especially Rose, was so warm and professional—she greeted me with a smile and made sure my appointment was perfectly organized.

Cynthia, the nail technician, did a fantastic job with my nails. She paid great attention to detail, took her time to make sure everything was perfect, and was so friendly throughout the process.

Roma, the hair stylist, was incredible. She listened carefully to what I wanted and gave me the perfect cut and style. I walked out of the salon feeling confident and so happy with how my hair looked!

I sent them a message right away, they didn't reply! Now after one week they replied and said: mam you should inform us within 2 days! Yes that's what I did!
